reason: Contract requires every nonzero finite FP16 input to satisfy a relative tolerance of 1e-6 against the real cube root. The exhaustive probe (tool event t6) tested all 63,488 finite FP16 values on the real GPU, using the artifact's own FP64 reference formula: 16,664 nonzero inputs violate the tolerance, with max relative error 1.5754e-6 (e.g. x=27.359375 → 3.0132563 vs target 3.0132516). Signed zeros map exactly to zero as required, but the single Newton correction step from the polynomial seed leaves residual error above the mandated tolerance across the entire legal domain — a clear, in-scope contract violation.
